  echo: false

```{r}
library(readr)
library(dplyr)
library(arrow)
library(knitr)

summaries <- readr::read_csv("../data/processed/r/subject_summaries.csv", show_col_types = FALSE)
cleaned <- arrow::read_parquet("../data/processed/r/cleaned_trials.parquet")
```

## 1. Compliance and Attrition Assertions

```{r}
total_subjects <- nrow(summaries)
compliant_subjects <- sum(summaries$is_compliant)
rejected_subjects <- sum(!summaries$is_compliant)

cat(sprintf("Total Cohort Size:    %d\n", total_subjects))
cat(sprintf("Compliant Subjects:   %d\n", compliant_subjects))
cat(sprintf("Rejected Subjects:    %d\n", rejected_subjects))

# Formal pipeline assertions
stopifnot("Cohort size must be exactly 50" = total_subjects == 50)
stopifnot("Must have exactly 49 compliant subjects" = compliant_subjects == 49)
stopifnot("Must have exactly 1 rejected subject (SUBJ_050)" = rejected_subjects == 1)

rejected_records <- summaries %>% filter(!is_compliant)
knitr::kable(
  rejected_records %>% select(participant_id, n_trials_raw, exclusion_reason, omission_rate_global),
  caption = "Excluded Cohort Records"
)
```

## 2. Data Cleaning Flags Distribution

```{r}
flag_summary <- cleaned %>%
  summarize(
    total_trials = n(),
    anticipations = sum(flag_anticipation),
    mad_outliers = sum(flag_mad_outlier),
    timeouts = sum(flag_timeout_lapse),
    retained_for_rt = sum(is_retained_for_rt),
    retained_for_sdt = sum(is_retained_for_sdt)
  )

knitr::kable(flag_summary, caption = "Global Non-Destructive Trial Audit Counts")
```

## 3. Condition Effects Sanity Verification

```{r}
compliant_data <- summaries %>% filter(is_compliant)

mean_conflict_slowing <- mean(compliant_data$conflict_cost_ms)
mean_wm_decay <- mean(compliant_data$wm_decay_cost_pct)
mean_hit_rate <- mean(compliant_data$ax_hit_rate)
mean_dprime_ctx <- mean(compliant_data$dprime_context)

cat(sprintf("Mean Target Hit Rate:     %.2f%%\n", mean_hit_rate * 100))
cat(sprintf("Mean Context d':          %.2f\n", mean_dprime_ctx))
cat(sprintf("Mean AY Conflict Slowing: %.2f ms (Target: > 50 ms)\n", mean_conflict_slowing))
cat(sprintf("Mean BX Delay Error Jump: %.2f%% (Target: > 10%%)\n", mean_wm_decay))

stopifnot("Hit rate must be > 85%" = mean_hit_rate > 0.85)
stopifnot("Conflict slowing must be positive (>40 ms)" = mean_conflict_slowing > 40.0)
stopifnot("WM decay must show error increase under delay (>10%)" = mean_wm_decay > 10.0)
```
